title: Nationwide public health emergency for the opioid crisis
actor: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services
source_title: Determination that a Public Health Emergency Exists, October 26 2017
summary: Acting HHS Secretary Eric D. Hargan determined that a public health emergency exists nationwide as a result of the opioid crisis.

title: Temporary placement of fentanyl-related substances in Schedule I
summary: DEA temporarily placed fentanyl-related substances in Schedule I. The order is a control on the chemical supply. The Federal Register issue date is February 6 2018.

title: SUPPORT for Patients and Communities Act becomes law
summary: Public Law 115-271, the SUPPORT for Patients and Communities Act, is noted as October 24 2018. It includes treatment, surveillance, and some controls on the opioid supply.

title: National emergency at the southern border, with construction authority
summary: Proclamation 9844 declared a national emergency at the southern border, cited illicit narcotics among the reasons, and made military construction authority available for the response.

title: China's class-wide control of fentanyl-related substances takes effect
source_title: White House statement on China's class scheduling of fentanyl
summary: China announced it would control fentanyl-related substances as a class. The control took effect May 1 2019. The White House statement describes that pledge.

title: Operation Blue Lotus begins
summary: ICE reported that Operation Blue Lotus, a DHS surge aimed at fentanyl smuggling, launched on March 13 2023.

title: Fentanyl combined with xylazine designated an emerging threat
actor: White House Office of National Drug Control Policy
summary: ONDCP designated fentanyl adulterated or associated with xylazine as an emerging threat on April 12 2023.

title: United States and China resume counternarcotics cooperation on precursors
actor: United States and the People's Republic of China
summary: At the November 15 2023 meeting, the two governments welcomed renewed cooperation against illicit fentanyl, including precursor chemicals and pill presses. A date is not evidence the commitment reduced deaths.

title: Southern-border entry suspension takes effect
summary: Proclamation 10773, Securing the Border, was signed June 3 2024. The suspension and limitation on entry across the southern border took effect at 12:01 a.m. eastern time on June 5 2024.

title: National emergency at the southern border, including construction authority
summary: Proclamation 10886 declared a national emergency at the southern border, cited illicit narcotics, made construction authority available, and revoked the 2021 proclamation that had ended the earlier border emergency.

title: Cartels designated for foreign-terrorist and sanctions process
summary: Executive Order 14157 of January 20 2025 starts a process for designating certain cartels as foreign terrorist organizations and specially designated global terrorists.

title: Duties on Chinese goods tied to the synthetic-opioid supply chain
summary: Executive Order 14195 of February 1 2025 imposed duties on products of China, citing the synthetic-opioid supply chain and chemical precursors.

title: Duties on Mexican goods tied to fentanyl trafficking
summary: Executive Order 14194 of February 1 2025 imposed duties on products of Mexico, citing illicit opioids and the failure to intercept trafficking at the southern border.

title: HALT Fentanyl Act becomes law
summary: Public Law 119-26, the Halt All Lethal Trafficking of Fentanyl Act, was approved July 16 2025. It permanently schedules fentanyl-related substances.
